question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the word "Rumpus"
solution: The correct answer is: **Commotion**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Rumpus"** refers to a noisy disturbance or commotion. (शोरगुल) • **Example:** There was a rumpus in the classroom when the teacher stepped out for a moment. • **"Commotion" **means a state of confused and noisy disturbance. (कोलाहल) • **Example:** The sudden appearance of a celebrity caused commotion among the crowd. • Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Rumpus' **is **'Commotion'**. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Commotion**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Calm **(शांत): A peaceful and quiet state, without any noise or disturbance. • **Example:** The sea was calm after the storm had passed. • **Silence **(मौन): Complete absence of sound or noise. • **Example:** The library was filled with silence as everyone was focused on reading. • **Harmony** (सामंजस्य): A state of peaceful agreement or coexistence. • **Example:** The family lived in harmony, supporting and caring for each other. 1c7:T49e,
